people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
translations.bsb: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.
